title: How To Perform The Z Press | Experts Only Shoulders Exercise
note: Review pass: Kept. Buff Dudes is on the reputable list, and the description confirms a barbell Z press ('Set your barbell on an elevated surface... Press the barbell'), so the variant matches. It is a focused 2:34 tutorial with chapters for form demonstration and how-to. No candidate was clearly better: BarBend/Rob Kearney (DkI_hV92ZKg) is the same age, and its Setup chapter does not say which implement it uses (it also has DB/KB chapters). Men's Health Muscle (FtxS_l-6kOU) has 2.2k views and doesn't name the implement. Brian Alsruhe (UCnd_nPlHOk) is 11:48 with the demo split across several chapters. Mind Pump has no chapters. PureGym (8s) has no implement stated. The barbell Shorts are all from unknown channels. Nippard, RP, Ethier, ATHLEAN-X, Squat U, Thrall, Juggernaut, Bell, Herman and Bodybuilding.com have no Z press demo.
